Less than Stellar
Jul 2026 • Solo
After an excellent Wagyu Striploin last time, I returned to Stellar Steakhouse for the Degustation Menu. The oyster was fresh and clean. The octopus confit was a letdown though, chewy and served with room-temperature mashed potato. While the Wagyu fillet was cooked to a precise medium-rare, the dry-aging left it tasting dry. Not much marbling or juiciness, and it ate like a standard lean cut. Even the mash was too salty. On the bright side, the Tiramisu Affogato was a creative standout. Hot espresso gave a lovely contrast in texture and temperature. Views and service were great. The cooking was just too inconsistent.

Dear Andy_scChan,

Thank you very much for taking the time to return to Stellar Steakhouse and, more importantly, for sharing such a detailed and honest review.

We truly appreciate your candid feedback, as it helps us recognize where we have fallen short and gives us the opportunity to improve. We are sincerely sorry that several dishes from our Degustation Menu did not meet the high standards you experienced during your previous visit.

Your comments regarding the octopus confit, the seasoning of the mashed potato, and the texture and overall enjoyment of the dry-aged Wagyu fillet have been shared with our culinary team for immediate review. Consistency is something we take great pride in, and it is clear that we did not deliver the level of excellence that both you and we expect.

At the same time, we are grateful to know that you enjoyed the oyster, the Tiramisu Affogato, as well as the views and service. Your balanced feedback is invaluable and encourages us to build on our strengths while addressing our weaknesses.

Thank you once again for your honesty and for helping us become a better restaurant. We genuinely hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the future, giving us the opportunity to demonstrate the improvements we have made based on feedback like yours. It would mean a great deal to us if your next experience reflects the level of quality and consistency that you rightfully expected from Stellar Steakhouse.

Great atmosphere, good food
Oct 2021
Decided to do something a bit more special with my fiancee so we booked a late dinner to Stellar Steakhouse starting 8.30pm. I have been to many steakhouses and fine dining venues, but I have to say, that the style of this Teppanyaki and the posh feeling you get when being escorted to your table really made the visit feel special. I loved to atmosphere, but not everything was perfect.

+ Great atmosphere
+ Superb staff and fast service
+ Variety in options 
+ Worth the money

- We were enjoying a nice dinner together and wanted to really relax after all the quarantines in Hanoi, but unfortunately even though we had a late booking, there were many young kids playing and being loud right next to us. Normally I wouldn't mind at all, but at this specific time we were looking to spend some quality relaxing time, but had to at times stop conversing while the kids were shouting loudly. This could easily be avoided by proper seating / different areas for families and couples. Not a big deal, but a slight inconvenience for the people enjoying a romantic relaxed dinner
- This was partly our fault for reserving a late time, but the time between meals was very short. We finished the 6 course meal in one hour which made it feel like we were hurried to get out despite the super friendly staff. I would recommend other to book an earlier time not too close to closing time.

As for the quality of the food, it was worth the money. I would give the restaurant 8/10 for Food, 10/10 for Service and 9/10 for Atmosphere (would be 10/10, but the loud noises made it a bit uncomfy at times).

p.s. the wine list was one of the best I have seen!
